WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('FY24/25',DATE '2024-11-25',DATE '2024-12-22'),('FY25/26',DATE '2025-11-24',DATE '2025-12-21')) t(yr,s,e)),
rpt AS (SELECT p.yr, sum(net_sales_before_returns) gross_rpt, sum(returns_net) ret_rpt, sum(net_sales) net_rpt FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN p ON r.business_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1),
fs AS (SELECT p.yr, sum(f.net_amount) all_st, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) excl_staff, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id<900 THEN f.net_amount END) st_lt900, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id<900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) st_lt900_nostaff, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id<900 AND f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) st_lt900_staff
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1),
fr AS (SELECT p.yr, sum(r.refund_net) ret_all, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id<900 THEN r.refund_net END) ret_lt900 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1)
SELECT * FROM rpt JOIN fs USING(yr) JOIN fr USING(yr) ORDER BY yr

WITH p AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('FY2024/25',DATE '2024-11-25',DATE '2024-12-22'),('FY2025/26',DATE '2025-11-24',DATE '2025-12-21')) t(fy,s,e)),
sl AS (SELECT p.fy, f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e),
rl AS (SELECT p.fy, r.* FROM fact_return_line r JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e)
SELECT 'sales' k, fy, count(*) n,
 count(*) - count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) dup_receipt_line,
 sum(CASE WHEN product_key NOT IN (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan_prod,
 sum(CASE WHEN store_key NOT IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan_store,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount IS NULL OR quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) odd_amt,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)<>sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utc_date_diff
FROM sl GROUP BY fy
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', fy, count(*), count(*)-count(distinct return_line_id),
 sum(CASE WHEN product_key NOT IN (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 sum(CASE WHEN sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 sum(CASE WHEN refund_net IS NULL OR refund_net<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 sum(CASE WHEN refund_net > (SELECT net_amount FROM fact_sales_line s WHERE s.sales_line_id=rl.sales_line_id)+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
 count(distinct sales_line_id) FROM rl GROUP BY fy
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH periods AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_period = 8 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
),
current_product AS (
  SELECT sku, CASE WHEN subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE category END AS category
  FROM dim_product WHERE is_current
),
movements AS (
  SELECT pe.fiscal_year, cp.category, f.net_amount AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product pr ON pr.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN current_product cp ON cp.sku = pr.sku
  JOIN periods pe ON f.sale_date BETWEEN pe.period_start_date AND pe.period_end_date
  WHERE st.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  SELECT pe.fiscal_year, cp.category, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product pr ON pr.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN current_product cp ON cp.sku = pr.sku
  JOIN periods pe ON r.return_date BETWEEN pe.period_start_date AND pe.period_end_date
  WHERE st.store_id <> 999
)
SELECT category, 8 AS fiscal_period,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amount END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amount END), 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
  round(100.0 * (sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN amount END) / sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN amount END) - 1), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM movements WHERE category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
